atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(10, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 3, 50, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.25, "Coil Threshold", 0.05, 0.5, 0.01)
vovRiseBars = input(3, "VoV Rise Bars", 2, 6, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.2, "Release Mult", 0.8, 3.0, 0.1)
predThreshold = input(0.55, "Predictability Threshold", 0.3, 0.9, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
tr = max(tr1, tr2)
tr = max(tr, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
atrSafe = max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
coilRatio = rng / atrSafe
coilHi = highest(coilRatio, coilLookback)
coilHiSafe = max(coilHi, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = 1 - (coilRatio / coilHiSafe)
atrHi = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrHiSafe = max(atrHi, 0.000000001)
atrCompress = 1 - (atrVal / atrHiSafe)
loadedScore = (coilLoad + atrCompress) / 2
atrAvg = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrAvgSafe = max(atrAvg, 0.000000001)
atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
volOfVol = atrSd / atrAvgSafe
vovHi = highest(volOfVol, coilLookback)
vovHiSafe = max(vovHi, 0.000000001)
volOfVolN = volOfVol / vovHiSafe
mom = abs(close - close[1])
momSum = sma(mom, predLen) * predLen
momSumSafe = max(momSum, 0.000000001)
disp = abs(close - close[predLen])
predictability = disp / momSumSafe
loadLine = 1 - coilThresh
isLoaded = loadedScore > loadLine
expandBase = rng > atrVal * releaseMult
expandUp = expandBase and close > high[1]
expandDn = expandBase and close < low[1]

var consecUp = 0.0
if volOfVol > volOfVol[1] {
  consecUp := consecUp[1] + 1
} else {
  consecUp := 0
}
volCoiling = consecUp >= vovRiseBars
isPredictable = predictability > predThreshold
coilReady = isLoaded and volCoiling
coilOnly = coilReady and not expandUp and not expandDn
buySig = coilReady and expandUp and isPredictable
sellSig = coilReady and expandDn and isPredictable
loadedUnpred = coilReady and not isPredictable
loadedPred = coilReady and isPredictable
coneSize = max(0.6, min(2.2, rng / atrSafe))
coneBuySize = coneSize * markerSize
coneSellSize = coneSize * markerSize

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if coilReady {
  bgcolor("#1b2a4a")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, loadedScore, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneBuySize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, loadedScore, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneSellSize, 0, "separate")
}
if loadedUnpred {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, loadedScore, "Coil-Unpred", "diamond", "#b48cff", coneBuySize, 0, "separate")
}
plot(loadedScore, "LoadedScore", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
plot(loadLine, "Loaded Line", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot3d(loadedScore, "Coil Load X", "scatter", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(volOfVolN, "VoV Norm Y", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability Z", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

SessionStartHour = input(0, "SessionStartHour", 0, 23, 1)
SessionLengthHours = input(8, "SessionLengthHours", 1, 24, 1)
StructureLookback = input(3, "StructureLookback", 1, 20, 1)
ConfirmationBars1H = input(2, "ConfirmationBars1H", 1, 5, 1)
BreakoutBufferTicks = input(2, "BreakoutBufferTicks", 0, 50, 1)
HardStopTicks = input(40, "HardStopTicks", 5, 500, 1)
MinStructureDisplacementTicks = input(15, "MinStructureDisplacementTicks", 1, 200, 1)

tickEst = close * 0.0001
bufferPx = BreakoutBufferTicks * tickEst
stopDistPx = HardStopTicks * tickEst
htfOpen = security("1h", open)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHighPrev = htfHigh[StructureLookback]
htfLowPrev = htfLow[StructureLookback]
htfClosePrev = htfClose[StructureLookback]
upStruct = htfHigh > htfHighPrev and htfLow > htfLowPrev
downStruct = htfHigh < htfHighPrev and htfLow < htfLowPrev
displacementTicks = abs(htfClose - htfClosePrev) / tickEst
dispOk = displacementTicks >= MinStructureDisplacementTicks
upperWick = htfHigh - htfClose
lowerBody = htfClose - htfLow
upperWick1 = htfHigh[1] - htfClose[1]
lowerBody1 = htfClose[1] - htfLow[1]
lowerWick = htfClose - htfLow
upperBody = htfHigh - htfClose
lowerWick1 = htfClose[1] - htfLow[1]
upperBody1 = htfHigh[1] - htfClose[1]
sessionLenBars = SessionLengthHours * 12
sessionOffset = SessionStartHour % sessionLenBars
newSession = bar_index % sessionLenBars == sessionOffset

var sessH = 0.0
var sessL = 0.0
var upCount = 0.0
var downCount = 0.0
var pos = 0.0
var entryPx = 0.0
var stopPx = 0.0

sessH := newSession ? high : max(sessH[1], high)
sessL := newSession ? low : min(sessL[1], low)
upCount := upStruct ? upCount[1] + 1 : 0
downCount := downStruct ? downCount[1] + 1 : 0
confirmedUp = upCount >= ConfirmationBars1H
confirmedDown = downCount >= ConfirmationBars1H
conflictUp = upperWick > lowerBody or (ConfirmationBars1H > 1 and upperWick1 > lowerBody1)
conflictDown = lowerWick > upperBody or (ConfirmationBars1H > 1 and lowerWick1 > upperBody1)
confLong = 50 + (dispOk ? 25 : 0) + (conflictUp ? 0 : 25)
confShort = 50 + (dispOk ? 25 : 0) + (conflictDown ? 0 : 25)
sessHPrev = sessH[1]
sessLPrev = sessL[1]
buySig = crossover(close, sessHPrev) and confirmedUp and pos <= 0
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLPrev) and confirmedDown and pos >= 0
longStopHit = pos == 1 and low <= stopPx
shortStopHit = pos == -1 and high >= stopPx
longReclaimExit = pos == 1 and crossunder(close, sessHPrev)
shortReclaimExit = pos == -1 and crossover(close, sessLPrev)
exitLong = longStopHit or longReclaimExit
exitShort = shortStopHit or shortReclaimExit

if buySig {
    entryPx := close + bufferPx
    stopPx := entryPx - stopDistPx
    pos := 1
    model.confidence(confLong / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopDistPx, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    entryPx := close - bufferPx
    stopPx := entryPx + stopDistPx
    pos := -1
    model.confidence(confShort / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopDistPx, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLong {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    pos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "diamond", "#ffaa00")
}
if exitShort {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    pos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "diamond", "#ffaa00")
}
plot(sessH, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessL, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(stopPx, "Hard Stop", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
